tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dgongs gter thugs kyi klong gsal gyi bka' brgyad lus dkyil 'don cha bsgrigs pa yod//

gu ru rin po che la phyag 'tshal nas// dgongs gter bka' brgyad lus dkyil 'don 'grigs dgod// chos bdag srung mas bka' gnang byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐: dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha: dran rdzogs dam ye dbyer med pa'i: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ka: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas pa'i phyag gsum rdo rje gsor: g.yon pa'i phyag gsum bhan+dha 'dzin: yum chen gnam zhal dbyings phyug 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud dril bu ste: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: byol song gtso brgyad dregs pa'i steng: bskal pa'i me dpung klong du bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: ma hā kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: dpral bar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ser zhal: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum be con ral gri s+t+wa: g.yon gsum sdigs mdzub mdung bhan dmar: yum chen badz+ra be ta lī: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: mgrin par dbang chen rta mchog rgyal: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus dmar zhal: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar sgrog: yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ma hā kro ta ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: thugs kar badz+ra he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal:

g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bhan rgyu zhags bsnams: yum chen kro dhī shwa rī 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: lte bar bla med he ru ka: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung sbrul zhags: g.yon gsum bhan+dha zhing ga 'u: yum chen nyid bzhi mu kha 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: ma lnga la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: gsang bar rdo rje gzhon nu che: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus ljang zhal: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga ste: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: tha gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: brla g.yas stobs ldan nag po che: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: dbu gsum mthing nag 'jigs pa la: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad snying: g.yon gsum bhan+dha klu brgyad snying: yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mo 'khril: g.yas pas gzugs khams mkha' la 'degs: g.yon pas 'dod khams sa la gnon: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: brla g.yon dregs pa kun 'dul rje: dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: g.yas gsum rdo rje lha brgyad mgo:

g.yon gsum bhan+dha klu brgyad mgo: yum chen srid pa spyi 'dul 'khril: g.yas pas gtso 'khyud kha ṭ+wāṃ ga: g.yon pas chags pa'i dung dmar stob: rigs lnga la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: spyi gtsug rig 'dzin rdo rje chos: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis bgrad: sku mdog dkar dmar rus rgyan mdzes: rigs lngas dbur brgyan thugs srog gsal: rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya bsgyur: yum chen chos dbyings rnal 'byor 'khril: gnyis med 'khril sbyor bde chen skyed: rigs bzhi la sogs 'khor bcas gsal: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kar ye shes sems: mthing nag zhi ba'i cha byad can: rdo rje dang ni dril bu bsnol: 'dor stabs bzhugs pa tshon gang tsam: de yi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag: nas 'bru tsam la rtsa sngags bskor: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha pad+ma kro dhī shwa rī badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma hā yak+sha kā la rū pa karmā raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: spro bsdu dang bcas bsnyen pa bya// mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor skad cig bskyed/ hūm̐: mdun du tshom bu dgu yi lha tshogs rnams: yab yum sras dang sprul pa 'khor dang bcas: bka' brgyad lha tshogs bdun brgya nyi shu rnams: phyogs mtshams med par 'od zer mtha' yas khengs: rang rang gnas gsum 'od kyis spyan drangs bstim: hūm̐: chos dbyings mnyam nyid rig pa'i ye shes lha: bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams: ma bcos lhun grub dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho a: sa ma ya a be sha ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rang rig ye shes lha la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: rang byung thabs shes dbyer med sman gyis mchod: rgyu rkyen rnam dag bdud rtsi gtor mas mchod: chags bral rak+ta dmar chen rdzas kyis mchod: phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchog: gnyis med blang dor med pa'i ngang du mchod: sarba pañtsa a mṛta la kha raṃ khā hi:

ma hā su kha khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta la khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: hūm̐: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: pad+ma gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: che mchog yon tan lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rig 'dzin slob dpon lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar bka' brgyad bdag mdun cha tshang 'di// sngon gyi gter rnying rnams nas bsdus te bsgrigs// gnad dang man ngag brgyud pa gsar pa ste// sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dgongs gter yin// dgongs gter gzhung du dmigs pa bsnyen sngags dang*// dbang bskur rtsa tshig rgyud tshig lta bu las// ngag tu 'don cha gsal bar ma byung bas// sprul sku nyid kyi dgongs pas rjes gnang phyir// 'don cha rā ga a s+yas bsgrigs pa la// nyes 'gal mchis na lha dang srung mar bshags// dge bas 'gro kun pad 'byung nyid 'grub shog// /
